cbuffer Constants : register(b0)

    row_major float4x4 world;

Texture2D<float> world_depth : register(t0);
Texture2D<float> cham_depth  : register(t1);
struct VSIn
    float3 pos    : POSITION;
    float3 normal : NORMAL;
    float2 uv     : TEXCOORD0;
struct PSIn
    float4 pos    : SV_POSITION;
    float3 wpos   : TEXCOORD0;
    float3 normal : NORMAL;
    float2 uv     : TEXCOORD1;
    float3 lpos   : TEXCOORD2; // mesh local 
PSIn vs_main(VSIn i)
    PSIn o;
    float4 wp = mul(world, float4(i.pos, 1.0));
    o.pos     = mul(view, wp);
    float dist = length(wp.xyz - camera);
    o.pos.z   = saturate(dist / 5000.0) * o.pos.w;
    o.wpos = wp.xyz;
    o.lpos = i.pos;
    // non-uniform scale 
 mul 
 chams 
 face-normal 
    o.normal = mul((float3x3)world, i.normal);
    o.uv = i.uv;
    return o;
float4 ps_depth(PSIn i) : SV_TARGET
    return float4(0, 0, 0, 0);
float4 ps_main(PSIn i) : SV_TARGET
    float3 V = normalize(camera - i.wpos);
    // 
 face normal 
 clip/
 normal 
 scale
    float3 dn = cross(ddy(i.wpos), ddx(i.wpos));
    float3 face_n = normalize(dn);
    if (dot(face_n, V) < 0.0)
        face_n = -face_n;
    float facing = saturate(dot(face_n, V));
    float3 N    = face_n;
    float  ndv  = facing;
    float  fres = pow(saturate(1.0 - ndv), max(0.1, fresnel_power));
    float3 L    = normalize(float3(0.45, 0.85, 0.30));
    float  ndl  = saturate(dot(N, L));
    float  lambert = ndl * 0.65 + 0.35;
    float3 H    = normalize(L + V);
    float  ndh  = saturate(dot(N, H));
    // fake env: hemisphere from normal
    float3 env  = pow(saturate(N * 0.5 + 0.5), 1.4);
    float4 bc = base_color;
    float4 fc = fresnel_color;
    int    m  = mode;
    if (occlusion_enabled != 0)
    {
        float cham_d  = i.pos.z;
        int2  sp      = int2(i.pos.xy);
        float w0 = world_depth.Load(int3(sp, 0));
        float w1 = world_depth.Load(int3(sp + int2(1, 0), 0));
        float w2 = world_depth.Load(int3(sp + int2(-1, 0), 0));
        float w3 = world_depth.Load(int3(sp + int2(0, 1), 0));
        float w4 = world_depth.Load(int3(sp + int2(0, -1), 0));
        float world_d = max(w0, max(w1, max(w2, max(w3, w4))));
        // dist-depth: 
 occluded
        if (cham_d > world_d + 0.0006)
        {
            bc = occluded_color;
            fc = occluded_fresnel;
            m  = occluded_mode;
        }
        else
        {
            bc = visible_color;
            fc = fresnel_color;
            m  = mode;
        }
    }
    float4 result = bc;
    if (m == 0) // flat
    {
        result.rgb = bc.rgb;
        result.a   = 1.0;
    }
    else if (m == 1) // chrome
    {
        float  spec   = pow(ndv, 14.0);
        result.rgb    = env * bc.rgb + spec.xxx * 0.6 + fc.rgb * fres;
        result.a      = 1.0;
    }
    else if (m == 2) // rainbow
    {
        float3 rainbow = 0.5 + 0.5 * cos(time * 2.0 + i.lpos * 0.35 + float3(0.0, 2.0, 4.0));
        result.rgb     = rainbow * lambert;
        result.a       = 1.0;
    }

    float4x4 g_MVP;

struct VS_Out {
    float4 pos : SV_POSITION;

    float2 uv  : TEXCOORD;
float4 main(VS_Out v) : SV_Target {
    float4 tex = g_Tex.Sample(g_Sam, v.uv);
    float3 n = normalize(v.nrm);
    float3 L = normalize(float3(0.45, 0.85, -0.35));
    float3 H = normalize(L + float3(0.0, 0.15, -1.0));
    float ndotl = saturate(dot(n, L));
    float spec = pow(saturate(dot(n, H)), 32.0) * 0.18;
    float wrap = saturate(ndotl * 0.65 + 0.35);
    float3 lit = tex.rgb * (0.28 + wrap * 0.82) + spec;
    lit = saturate((lit - 0.5) * 1.08 + 0.5);
    return float4(lit, saturate(g_Opacity.x));

float hash(float n) { return frac(sin(n) * 43758.5453); }
float noise(float3 x)
    float3 p = floor(x);
    float3 f = frac(x);
    f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
    float n = p.x + p.y * 57.0 + p.z * 113.0;
    return lerp(lerp(lerp(hash(n), hash(n + 1.0), f.x),
                     lerp(hash(n + 57.0), hash(n + 58.0), f.x), f.y),
               lerp(lerp(hash(n + 113.0), hash(n + 114.0), f.x),
                     lerp(hash(n + 170.0), hash(n + 171.0), f.x), f.y), f.z);
float fbm(float3 p)
    float a = 0.0, w = 0.5;
    [unroll] for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    {
        a += w * noise(p);
        p = p * 2.03 + 0.15;
        w *= 0.5;
    }
    return a;
float liquid(float3 d, float t)
    float3 q = d * 2.35;
    q += t * float3(0.055, 0.028, -0.042);
    float3 w = float3(fbm(q), fbm(q + 17.2), fbm(q + 31.7));
    q += (w - 0.5) * 1.05;
    w = float3(fbm(q * 1.55 + t * 0.035), fbm(q * 1.55 + 9.4), fbm(q * 1.55 + 21.1));
    q += (w - 0.5) * 0.55;
    return fbm(q);
float3 ramp(float u)
    u = saturate(u);
    float3 c0 = float3(0.06, 0.10, 0.28);
    float3 c1 = float3(0.08, 0.24, 0.34);
    float3 c2 = float3(0.24, 0.12, 0.36);
    float3 c3 = float3(0.38, 0.12, 0.26);
    float3 c4 = float3(0.34, 0.18, 0.24);
    float3 c5 = float3(0.30, 0.22, 0.18);
    if (u < 0.20) return lerp(c0, c1, u / 0.20);
    if (u < 0.40) return lerp(c1, c2, (u - 0.20) / 0.20);
    if (u < 0.60) return lerp(c2, c3, (u - 0.40) / 0.20);
    if (u < 0.80) return lerp(c3, c4, (u - 0.60) / 0.20);
    return lerp(c4, c5, (u - 0.80) / 0.20);
float4 ps_main(float4 pos : SV_POSITION) : SV_TARGET
    float2 r = res;
    if (r.x < 2.0 || r.y < 2.0)
        r = float2(1920, 1080);
    float2 uv = pos.xy / r * float2(2, -2) + float2(-1, 1);
    float3 dir;
    if (dot(inv_vp[0], inv_vp[0]) < 1e-6)
        dir = normalize(float3(uv, 1));
    else
    {
        float4 n = mul(inv_vp, float4(uv, 0, 1));
        float4 f = mul(inv_vp, float4(uv, 1, 1));
        n.xyz /= max(abs(n.w), 1e-4);
        f.xyz /= max(abs(f.w), 1e-4);
        dir = normalize(f.xyz - n.xyz);
    }
    float t = time;
    int im = (int)(mode + 0.5);
    float3 col;
    if (im == 3)
    {
        float2 vu = pos.xy / r;
        if (vu.x < 0.0 || vu.x > 1.0 || vu.y < 0.0 || vu.y > 1.0)
            return float4(0, 0, 0, 1);
        float3 c = saturate(vid.SampleLevel(smp, vu, 0).rgb);
        float w = max(c.r, max(c.g, c.b));
        c *= 0.42 / (0.42 + w);
        return float4(c, 1);
    }
    else if (im == 1)
    {
        float h = liquid(dir, t);
        float hx = liquid(normalize(dir + float3(0.012, 0, 0)), t);
        float hy = liquid(normalize(dir + float3(0, 0.012, 0)), t);
        float g = length(float2(hx - h, hy - h));
        col = ramp(h * 0.72 + 0.10 + 0.04 * sin(t * 0.18));
        col += pow(saturate(g * 16.0), 7.0) * 0.16;
        float ir = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(h * 6.2 + t * 0.14);
        col = lerp(col, col.bgr * float3(0.95, 0.88, 1.02), ir * 0.10);
        col = lerp(float3(0.08, 0.10, 0.20), col, 0.84);
    }
    else if (im == 2)
    {
        float az = atan2(dir.z, dir.x);
        float el = dir.y;
        float curtain = 0.0;
        [unroll] for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
        {
            float a = az * (2.15 + i * 0.52) + t * (0.20 + i * 0.045);
            float wave = sin(a) + 0.42 * sin(a * 1.65 + t * 0.14 + i);
            float y = (el - 0.42) * 1.85 - wave * 0.22 - i * 0.05;
            float sheet = exp(-y * y * (6.2 + i * 2.0));
            float hgt = saturate((el - 0.10) * 4.2) * saturate(1.2 - el * 0.85);
            curtain += sheet * hgt * (0.58 - i * 0.08);
        }
        float n = fbm(float3(dir.x, el, dir.z) * 2.35 + t * 0.055);
        float n2 = fbm(dir * 4.1 - t * 0.04);
        float rays = pow(saturate(curtain * (0.72 + 0.48 * n)), 1.08);
        float dome = saturate((el - 0.14) * 1.7);
        col = float3(0.04, 0.06, 0.13);
        col = lerp(col, float3(0.05, 0.22, 0.16), dome * 0.55);
        col = lerp(col, float3(0.05, 0.42, 0.22), saturate(rays * 1.55));
        col = lerp(col, float3(0.16, 0.76, 0.44), saturate(rays * n * 1.85));
        col = lerp(col, float3(0.32, 0.86, 0.80), saturate(rays * n2 * 1.05) * saturate(el * 1.2));
        col += float3(0.64, 0.16, 0.46) * saturate(curtain * 0.7) * saturate(el - 0.18) * saturate(0.55 - el) * (0.5 + 0.5 * n);
    }
    else
    {
        float cs = cos(t * 0.42), sn = sin(t * 0.42);
        float3 p = float3(dir.x * cs + dir.z * sn, dir.y, -dir.x * sn + dir.z * cs);
        p += 0.30 * sin(float3(p.y, p.z, p.x) * 1.62 + t * 0.68);
        p += 0.14 * sin(float3(p.z, p.x, p.y) * 2.35 - t * 0.51);
        float3 k = float3(
            0.502 + 0.048 * sin(t * 0.37),
            0.478 + 0.044 * sin(t * 0.51 + 2.1),
            0.508 + 0.036 * cos(t * 0.29 + 4.2));
        float acc = 0.0;
        float rim = 10.0;
        [unroll] for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i)
        {
            p = abs(p);
            float d2 = dot(p, p);
            p = p / max(d2, 1e-4) - k;
            float l = length(p);
            rim = min(rim, l);
            acc += exp(-l * 2.15);
        }
        float a = saturate(acc * 0.155);
        float shell = saturate(a * 1.35) * saturate(1.55 - acc * 0.09);
        col = lerp(float3(0.05, 0.06, 0.14), float3(0.12, 0.13, 0.30), saturate(shell * 1.8));
        col = lerp(col, float3(0.58, 0.52, 0.92), saturate(shell * 1.2 - 0.15));
        col += float3(0.86, 0.88, 1.0) * saturate(0.55 - rim) * shell * 0.85;
    }
    float3 mulc = tint.rgb;
    if (dot(mulc, mulc) < 1e-6)
        mulc = 1;
    col = max(col * mulc, float3(0.04, 0.045, 0.07));
    return float4(saturate(col), 1);

local function make_sub_enum(ename)
    return setmetatable({}, {
        __index = function(self, key)
            local val = { Name = key, EnumType = ename, Value = 0 }
            setmetatable(val, {
                __tostring = function() return ename .. "." .. key end,
                __eq = function(a, b)
                    if type(a) == "table" and type(b) == "table" then
                        return a.Name == b.Name and a.EnumType == b.EnumType
                    end
                    return false
                end
            })
            rawset(self, key, val)
            return val
        end

struct VSOut { float4 pos : SV_POSITION; float2 uv : TEXCOORD0; };
VSOut vs_main(uint id : SV_VertexID)
    VSOut o;
    float2 uv = float2((id << 1) & 2, id & 2);
    o.uv  = uv;
    o.pos = float4(uv * float2(2.0, -2.0) + float2(-1.0, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0);
    return o;
Texture2D    src : register(t0);
SamplerState smp : register(s0);
cbuffer Params : register(b0) { float2 texel; float2 dir; };
// 4 bilinear taps = 16 texel box, keeps the downsample smooth.
float4 ps_down(VSOut i) : SV_TARGET
    float2 o = texel * 0.5;
    float3 c = src.Sample(smp, i.uv + float2(-o.x, -o.y)).rgb
             + src.Sample(smp, i.uv + float2( o.x, -o.y)).rgb
             + src.Sample(smp, i.uv + float2(-o.x,  o.y)).rgb
             + src.Sample(smp, i.uv + float2( o.x,  o.y)).rgb;
    return float4(c * 0.25, 1.0);
// 9-tap gaussian folded into 5 bilinear fetches per axis.
float4 ps_blur(VSOut i) : SV_TARGET
    const float w0 = 0.2270270270;
    const float w1 = 0.3162162162, o1 = 1.3846153846;
    const float w2 = 0.0702702703, o2 = 3.2307692308;
    float2 d = dir * texel;
    float3 c = src.Sample(smp, i.uv).rgb * w0;
    c += src.Sample(smp, i.uv + d * o1).rgb * w1;
    c += src.Sample(smp, i.uv - d * o1).rgb * w1;
    c += src.Sample(smp, i.uv + d * o2).rgb * w2;
    c += src.Sample(smp, i.uv - d * o2).rgb * w2;
    return float4(c, 1.0);
